metadata.title: feat: migrate Gateways component from /gateways to /servers endpoint
metadata.author: vishu-bh

description:
Migrates Gateways.tsx from legacy /gateways to new /servers endpoint with updated types, comprehensive tests, and new virtual servers listing UI.

Key Changes:
- Created BaseServer interface to eliminate field duplication
- Added VirtualServer type with camelCase fields matching /servers response
- Updated Gateways component to use /servers endpoint
- Added new virtual servers list UI with server cards showing status, tools, resources, and prompts
- Updated field mappings: reachable to enabled, tool_count to associatedToolIds.length
- Updated timestamps to camelCase: createdAt/updatedAt
- Fixed unit tests and added comprehensive E2E test suite (18 test cases)

Test Results: 63 unit tests passing, 30 E2E tests passing (1 skipped)

reviews.author: marekdano
reviews.body:
#### Blocking issues:

  - `getServerTags` is a no-op wrapper (`Gateways.tsx:37-39`). It literally does return server.tags. This adds no abstraction — just use `server.tags` inline in `VirtualServerCard`. Dead helpers create confusion about what invariant they're protecting.
  - `useMemo` with no real dependencies is misleading (`Gateways.tsx:222-227`). The `queryPath` memo has an empty dependency array because `DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE` is a module constant. This signals to readers "this has a meaningful memoization reason" when it doesn't. 
      - Either lift it to a module-level constant:
```bash
  const SERVERS_QUERY_PATH = `/servers?limit=${DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE}&include_pagination=true`;
```

    or just build the string inline — it's one line.

  
  - `actionCards` array is recreated on every render (`Gateways.tsx:228-256`). It's declared inside the `Gateways` function with no dependency that changes, yet it's not memoized. Move it above the component or wrap in `useMemo`. This is a minor perf issue but matters as the component grows.


####  Non-blocking issues:

  - `VirtualServer required fields may be over-constrained (server.ts:70-85). Fields like `teamId, team, ownerEmail, createdBy, createdFromIp, createdVia, createdUserAgent` are typed as required non-nullable strings.
  If the API can ever return null for these (as it does for `modifiedBy, modifiedFromIp, etc.`), this will cause silent runtime failures. Cross-check against the backend schema. At a minimum, add `| null` where the backend permits it.
  - `associatedTools`: `string[]` vs `associatedToolIds: string[]` (server.ts:60-61). Having both in the same interface is confusing — the name associatedTools implies rich objects but holds strings. If it's always empty or redundant with associatedToolIds, consider dropping it or clarifying its purpose in a comment.

commits.message:
feat: migrate Gateways component from /gateways to /servers endpoint

- Refactor type hierarchy with BaseServer interface to eliminate duplication
- Add VirtualServer interface with camelCase fields matching /servers response
- Update Gateways.tsx to use /servers endpoint and VirtualServer type
- Change field mappings: reachable→enabled, tool_count→associatedToolIds.length
- Update timestamps to use camelCase: createdAt/updatedAt
- Remove transport field from getServerTags (not in VirtualServer)
- Fix unit tests to match new endpoint and response structure
- Add comprehensive E2E test suite (18 tests, 30 passing, 1 skipped)
- Update test expectations for new API structure

Closes #<issue-number>

commits.message:
fix(gateways): disable placeholder UI, harden null-safety and tests

Surface unimplemented Virtual Server actions as visibly disabled instead
of silent no-ops, and harden the page against missing array fields.

- VirtualServerCard: disable Upload button and View/Test/Edit/Delete
  dropdown items so they no longer fire silent click handlers.
- SourceSelection: mark REST API and gRPC source cards as disabled with
  a "Coming soon" reason; the connect button no longer triggers a
  console.log-only no-op and the card is excluded from the default
  highlight.
- Apply optional chaining to associated tool/resource/prompt counts and
  default tags to an empty array so the card cannot crash when the API
  omits these collections.
- Update VirtualServer type to mark associated*/tags fields as optional,
  matching the defensive code paths and removing an "as unknown as"
  cast in the test.

Tests:
- Add data-testid hooks (virtual-server-card, enabled-indicator,
  tool-count, resource-count, prompt-count, last-updated,
  action-card-<title>) so unit and Playwright tests stop relying on
  Tailwind class substrings.
- Replace brittle [class*="..."] and span:has-text("0") locators with
  the new testids.
- Drop the misleading "shows partial error" Playwright case (it was
  asserting against a fully successful response).
- Cover the new disabled states in unit and Playwright tests, and add
  a unit test that renders a virtual server card from a partial
  payload.
- Mock useQuery in App.test.tsx so the post-login Gateways navigation
  is deterministic.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
